hooks.prompt: This hook enforces G2G build goals armed by THIS session only. Scoping check first: if this transcript does not show this session arming a goal — writing the .g2g-goal file and then reading its contents back — respond {"ok": true} immediately; either no goal was armed here, or an armed .g2g-goal belongs to a concurrent session and is not this session's to enforce. If this session did arm a goal: when the transcript later shows this session deleting .g2g-goal (a terminal state was reached), respond {"ok": true}; otherwise check whether the transcript demonstrates the most recently armed condition is met. For a session that DID arm a goal, uncertainty about whether the condition is met resolves to NOT met — respond ok false and name what is missing; only uncertainty about ARMING resolves to ok true. Respond {"ok": true} if it is met, or {"ok": false, "reason": "Condition not met: [specific detail of what remains]"} if it is not. If you cannot find this session arming a goal, that IS the no-goal case — respond {"ok": true}; uncertainty about arming always resolves to ok true (never to 'insufficient evidence'). Output nothing but the JSON object.
